prompts.name: library
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Library room background for a personal website, opaque 1536x1024 landscape PNG. The most recent Great Hall image is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create an adjoining library in the SAME castle, with exactly its fine black-and-white stipple/engraved pen-and-ink texture, dense small dots, deep solid black shadow areas, white edge lighting and medieval stonework. Straight-on theatrical interior composition, shallow perspective, same scale of masonry and details. Tall stone ribbed vaults across the top; book-filled shelves recessed into stone arches at the left and right edges. Left side: worn tall wooden bookshelves and a slender leaning library ladder. Right side: a narrow pointed moonlit window at the outer edge, bookshelves and a small antique globe on a stand. Lower corners: several stacked folios, flagstone floor. A spacious quiet shadowed central bay, without a focal object: a white reading window will be placed by the website over the central 55% width starting 12% down. Put all distinguishing library objects in the outermost 22% on either side and architectural vaulting above, so they remain visible around that overlay. Still draw a complete natural room behind the eventual panel, not an empty rectangular hole. Match the reference's crisp stippling closely: no coarse pixel blocks, photographic realism, smooth gradients, colored tints or blurry shading. No people, no actual UI or white panel, no lettering/text/title, no frame, no watermark. This is ONLY the background room illustration. Keep bookcases legible at the far edges even when the middle is covered.

prompts.name: observatory
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Observatory room background, opaque 1536x1024 landscape PNG. The supplied Great Hall is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE only. Create an adjoining upper-tower observatory in the same medieval castle. Match the fine monochrome stippled pen-and-ink engraving, dense tiny dots, crisp white edges, deep black shadows, stone blocks, and ribbed vault architecture exactly. Straight-on theatrical interior, shallow perspective, same detail scale as the reference. Broad ribbed stone arches along the upper edge; on the far LEFT a tall open pointed arch with a moon and starry night sky, and a long antique telescope on a sturdy tripod angled upward toward that opening, fully visible in the leftmost 22% of the image. On the far RIGHT an ornate armillary sphere on a pedestal, an astronomical chart of fine constellation lines and circles pinned to stone, and a small shelf of rolled maps. Flagstone floor, low worktable with closed folios at the right edge. Central bay is quiet shadowed stone, no focal object: the website will overlay a white reading window in the center 55% width starting 12% from the top. Put distinctive observatory instruments and details at the outer edges where they remain visible around the window; leave clear upper vaulting above it. Render a COMPLETE natural room, not a blank rectangular hole. Antique astronomy rather than magic or modern space equipment. No people, no lettering, no actual UI/window/panel, no frames or borders, no colors, no photographic gray gradients, no blurry airbrush, no chunky pixels. Fine stippling matching the Great Hall is essential.

prompts.name: workshop
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Workshop room background for a website, opaque 1536x1024 landscape PNG. The most recent Great Hall image is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE only. Create the castle's adjoining craftsman's workshop, matching exactly the fine monochrome stippled pen-and-ink engraving, dense tiny dots, deep solid black shadows, white rim details and medieval stone blocks in that reference. Straight-on theatrical composition, shallow perspective, ribbed stone vaults along the upper edge, flagstone floor. Place distinctive workshop objects in the outermost 22% at each side, leaving a quiet shadowed central stone bay. A website will overlay the central 55% width with a white reading panel starting 12% down; DO NOT paint that panel. LEFT EDGE: a tall rack of hand tools (saw, hammers, tongs, dividers), sturdy timber workbench with vise, a partially assembled small clockwork device with exposed gears, a few neatly stored boards below. RIGHT EDGE: narrow pointed moonlit window, shelves of tools and small experimental mechanical devices, a wooden wheel, a hanging chain and pulley and a low cabinet with drawers. A few rolled diagrams with NO legible text. Practical workshop rather than alchemy laboratory or torture chamber. Complete natural room behind the eventual overlay, no blank rectangular hole. Keep tools and bench visible at far edges even when the middle is covered. Same crisp tiny stipple and stone detail scale as the Hall, no chunky pixels, smooth photo gradients, airbrush or color. No people, text, UI, actual window panel, frame, border, logos, watermark or modern computers.

prompts.name: journal-desk
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: background for a readable Captain's Log journal on a website, opaque 1536x1024 landscape PNG. The supplied Great Hall is ONLY the reference for fine black-and-white stippled engraving, medieval materials and precise tiny dot detail. Create a CLOSE-UP TOP-DOWN view of a dark antique writing desk in that castle. This is a tabletop still life, NOT another room: no walls, arches, floor or panoramic architecture. The tabletop fills the canvas, made of broad aged wooden planks rendered in mostly deep black with restrained fine white engraved grain. Center 65% width is uncluttered dark desk because the website will place a large open white book over it. DO NOT draw the book or any central paper/panel. Frame the empty working area with objects at the far edges: far LEFT a small burning candle in a metal holder near the top, a few sealed folded letters and a spare quill near bottom left; far RIGHT a black inkwell and long white feather quill angled along the edge, an antique key and a small closed leather notebook near bottom right. All objects remain in the outermost 15% on either side. Tiny scattered ink marks okay. Calm, intimate, practical writing surface; no skulls, weapons or magical objects. Match the Hall's monochrome fine stippling/engraving, sharp white edges against rich blacks, NO photographic gray gradients or warm sepia, no chunky pixel blocks. No people, hands, writing, text, UI, open book, parchment in the center, border or watermark. Compose for a central reading overlay while leaving candle, quill and inkwell visible around it.
